name: Do I need a permit for bathroom accessibility modifications in South San Francisco?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for bathroom accessibility modifications in South San Francisco?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you need a permit for bathroom accessibility modifications in South San Francisco depends on the scope of the work. Minor cosmetic changes, like painting or installing grab bars, typically do not require a permit. However, any structural alterations, plumbing changes, electrical work, or reconfiguring the layout will likely require permits from the City of South San Francisco Planning and Building Department. It's best to consult with a contractor or the city directly before starting any significant project.
